name: board-game-catalog
description: Board Game Wall: a public catalog of a board game collection

scripts.deploy: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && npx wrangler deploy

DB.description: Database for favorites and plays. The tables are created automatically at the first deploy.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Owner password, max 16 characters: you will type it on the site to change favorites and record plays. Do not reuse a password you use elsewhere.
